title: One Day in Barcelona
text: We had a wonderful time during our sightseeing tour with Naeem. I was able to communicate with him prior to our trip in order to plan our trip seeing the sights we wanted to see.  Naeem was very patient when my in-laws decided to change our plans mid-day.  He was extremely knowledgeable of the city and made suggestions about things to do after our tour.  We highly recommend using this service and would ask for Naeem if you are able.  He made the trip for my in-laws stress free and extremely enjoyable.
author: WPChristine

title: Unforgettable Barcelona
text: We had the privilege of having Alexandru SERDARU as our guide and driver for a full-day tour of Barcelona, and he exceeded every expectation. From the moment we met him, his warmth and friendliness put us completely at ease. His knowledge of the city’s history, culture, and hidden gems was remarkable, and he shared it in a way that was both engaging and easy to follow. What impressed us most was his thoughtfulness and attention to detail, ensuring we were comfortable throughout. author: Dinakar A

title: Great Tour
text: Syed was a great guide. I saw all the places I was interested in. We stopped at a great tapas restaurant.
author: Philip_W

title: Eventful day in Barcelona
text:
The driver was on time and had plenty of suggestions for our itinerary. He was knowledgeable
about the city and helped us organize our tour so we could make the most of or day. Highlights included the Miro and Picasso museum exhibits, Gothic quarter and Ramblas, the  Cathedral,
Temple of Agustus, Casa Batllo, the Maritime Museum and Sagrada Família. We had plenty of time to do the museums on our own and he was always waiting for us outside when we were ready to move on. He also had great suggestions for dining, and delivered us back to our hotel.
author: William_W
